castTime.binNote: Base cast time is 0.25 (Cast_Time_Base), shrinking to a minimum of 0.175 (Cast_Time_Min) as bonus attack speed rises to 125% (Cast_Time_Attack_Speed_Cap); the field records the base value only.

values.binNote: The wiki writes the cost as 40% of the true-damage value (base and AD ratio both scaled by 0.4), which matches the bin's separate BaseHealthCost/HealthCostADRatio track (28/46/64/82/100 base, 0.2 AD ratio = 0.5*0.4) computed via HealthCostCalc = TotalDamage * HealthCostPercent.

values.meaning: Cooldown reduction per basic attack on a champion
values.quote: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.

values.meaning: Cooldown reduction per basic attack on a monster
values.quote: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.

mechanics.claim: If Reckless Swing kills the target, Olaf heals himself for the amount of the health cost paid.
mechanics.quote: If ''Reckless Swing'' kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heals}} himself equal to the {{as|{{sti|health|health cost}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Reckless Swing's cast time shortens with bonus attack speed, down to a minimum, so higher attack speed lets it be cast (and thus deal its true damage) more quickly.
Reckless Swing can be cast even without enough health to pay the cost, and it will never reduce Olaf's health below 1.
mechanics.quote: ''Reckless Swing'' can be cast even if '''Olaf''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost.

mechanics.claim: The health refund from a kill is a heal, so it is affected by healing modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Reckless Swing's'' health refund is considered a {{tip|heal}} therefore it is affected by healing modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks reduce Reckless Swing's cooldown by 1 second against champions, increased to 2 seconds against monsters.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.

mechanics.claim: The health cost is not a separate resource pool but computed as 40% of the true damage value.
mechanics.quote: The health cost is equal to 40% of ''Reckless Swing's'' {{as|true damage}} value.
